lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D array of high-luminance circular centroids organized into at least six visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher luminance that intersect the horizontal spot alignments, forming a lattice of high-intensity nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal lineaments with sharp vertical intensity gradients (light superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) spanning the length of the visible upper flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct low-luminance, elongated spindle-shaped feature (consistent with a remora) attached to the lower lateral flank just anterior to the pectoral fin.
